title: Production router is missing worker_type telemetry
description:
## Behaviour

M8 closed with claim/complete writing `worker_type` (`local` / `batch`). Live DynamoDB has **no** items with `worker_type`. The production router Lambda `AuritusBackend-RouterFnDA4EF4F3-jclSBvAjL2tV` was last modified **2026-09-13T03:37:47Z**, before PR #40.

The operator console race split cannot be true on AWS until that Lambda is redeployed from current `develop`.

## Fix

`cdk deploy AuritusBackend` (or `auritus deploy`) from current develop so the live API matches git. Then a newly claimed job must store `worker_type`.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Production AuritusBackend redeployed after rollback. The first changeset failed because Cognito rejects ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH when refresh-token rotation is enabled. That override is gone.

Router Lambda LastModified is 2026-09-13T23:04:31Z. A new job 325b9a6bf2554c20 claimed as local:telemetry-proof returned worker_type=local. API URL unchanged.

PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Auritus/pull/45

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Closed: live router writes worker_type. Deployed AuritusBackend; job 325b9a6bf2554c20 claimed as local. CDK CLI pin landed in https://github.com/AnthusAI/Auritus/pull/45

right_now_summary: The production router now writes worker_type, confirmed by a live job claiming as local.
